{{Top|leg}}
'''Flash-netting''' was a form of camouflage netting used to hide starships.<ref name="DFR">''[[Dark Force Rising]]''</ref>

While hiding out on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] planet<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]], [[Lachton]], one of [[Talon Karrde|Talon Karrde]]'s men, requested more flash-netting to finish camouflaging their ships. Karrde sent [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] to the [[Number 3 Supply Dump|Number Three dump]] on [[Wozwashi Street]] to pick up additional boxes of flash-netting for the task.<ref name="DFR" />
